skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Ability to understand main ideas and take notes on key details from monologues and dialogues up to 4-5 minutes long in business communication settings and daily life.
Recognition and understanding of 100-120 vocabulary items related to business and daily life situations.
Ability to speak about familiar topics using most simple sentence structures and basic linking devices effectively.
Ability to read and understand main ideas from texts of 100-200 words on familiar topics in business and daily life.
Ability to construct simple sentences and combine them using basic linking devices to form short descriptive paragraphs or letters.
